label: first two copy-phase outputs of long sequences (L>=8)
explanation: Fires almost only in the copy phase (99.6% of mass); never on the original tokens (except a little at orig_idx 8) or on the <DEL> step. The peak is the step right after <DEL> (recall_idx 1, input = first original token, 62% of mass), then recall_idx 2 (18%). The rate rises sharply with sequence length (L<=5 essentially never; L=9 holds 63% of mass). A smaller secondary bump comes near the end of the copy for long sequences (recall_idx 7-8, about 10% of mass), which this predicate misses. Magnitude depends on the input token: the top activations are all at recall_idx 1 with first token v, j or g, and v/j/g/b inputs fire at about 3x the base rate. Mid-copy steps (recall_idx 3-6) are weak, and short sequences are silent.
